title: Nvidia Maintains Open-Source AI Strategy After Huang's Departure
excerpt: Nvidia's interim CEO confirms the company's open-source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face following Jensen Huang's exit.
body_html:
Nvidia has confirmed that its open-source artificial intelligence strategy will remain unchanged following the sudden departure of Jensen Huang.

The company's interim chief executive officer reaffirmed the ongoing commitment to open-source initiatives. In addition to maintaining this strategic direction, the leadership confirmed plans to proceed with the acquisition of Hugging Face.

These developments follow the unexpected exit of Jensen Huang, though current management intends to stay the course regarding these major technology and business objectives.
